scenario_inputs.market_cap_basis: vendor market-cap snapshot at the live price (342.96 USD as of 2026-10-14); the same input the standard implied_fcf figure uses
scenario_inputs.scenario_definition: Mechanical scenarios: the historical multiple is applied to the current market capitalization, so the implied figure is the free cash flow that price would correspond to at that multiple. None of these is a forecast, a fair value, a probability, or a recommendation, and none is selected as a conclusion.

known_gaps: The vendor P/FCF band is UNAVAILABLE (its market-cap and FCF series share no dates); the production reconstruction is the only historical P/FCF reference, and the two are never merged.

consensus_cross_check.price_at_historical_median_pe is null because that field reads the vendor historical P/E band only; the production P/E median exists but is not wired into this cross-check field. Recorded as a method-scope gap, not backfilled.

The matrix's cash-flow method requires an explicitly supplied multiple; the historical percentile scenarios in this artifact are computed outside the matrix and are labelled as explicit scenario inputs.

The reconstruction's latest evaluation date is the canonical price series' last trading day (2026-10-06), which is earlier than the market price date (2026-10-14); the two are never presented as the same date.
